How to read this: an account gets the expansion signal when its usage over the last 28 days is more than 10% above the prior 28 days. Signalled accounts expanded the next month 67% of the time, versus 29% for the rest.

The usage data has a planted effect: usage ramps up before expansion months, so this gap is there by design, to test that the pipeline recovers a known relationship. With the effect switched off, both groups expand 46% of the time. It is not a finding. See the repo README.
